request: Analyze GSE236613 for the paper (Anti-osteoporosis mechanism of resistance exercise in ovariectomized rats based on transcriptome analysis: a pilot study): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero), left tibia, Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (S2.7.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: 3 left tibias per group sequenced out of 6 rats per group (S2.7.p1); 9 samples total
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 12 weeks of ladder-climbing resistance exercise on tibia gene expression in ovariectomized rats: RE/Ovx vs NE/Ovx (S3.4.p2, S4.p3)
planned_contrasts: RE/Ovx vs NE/Ovx (S3.4.p2; paper: 4423 DEGs, 2227 up / 2196 down) - exercise effect, primary
NE/Ovx vs Sham (S3.4.p2; paper: 6697 DEGs, 4040 up / 2657 down) - ovariectomy model effect, secondary (not an exercise contrast)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; one tibia per independent rat
final.paper_method: DESeq2 on RNA-seq counts (S2.8.p1); exact design (all 9 samples vs per-pair subset) not stated
final.paper_results: DEG counts S3.4.p2; 401/213 OP-related DEGs after DisGeNET/OMIM intersection (S3.4.p3); RT-qPCR genes Acp5, Fos, Fosb up in NE vs Sham and down in RE vs NE, Calcr opposite, Stat1 up in RE vs NE (S3.7.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.1.p1 three randomized groups; S2.7.p1 3 tibias per group sequenced; S2.8.p1 DESeq2, p < 0.05 and FC > 1.2 or < 0.83; S3.4.p2 reports both pairwise comparisons with counts. Exercise estimand is RE/Ovx vs NE/Ovx; NE/Ovx vs Sham is the model contrast the paper also reports.

checks: GEO series GSE236613: rat tibias, treatment levels sham-operated / non-exercise / resistance exercise, 3 each, matching S2.7.p1
contact Qing Wang, Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine = first author QW and institution (S2.1.p1, S7.p1)
paper data availability statement (S5.p1) gives no accession; ownership rests on design, tissue, organism, institution and author match

ownership.reasoning: Metadata organism Rattus norvegicus, tissue tibias, 9 samples split 3/3/3 into Sham / Ovx_NE / Ovx_RE titles, submitter Qing Wang at NJUCM, matching the paper. The paper itself names no GEO accession (S5.p1).

alignment.reasoning: The prep script renamed each GSM*_SampleN_counts column to its GSM accession, which equals the metadata index (geo_accession). grp copies the treatment characteristic and recodes it to Sham / NE (NE/Ovx) / RE (RE/Ovx); titles (Sham_*, Ovx_NE_*, Ovx_RE_*) agree.

matrix.reasoning: Per-sample *_counts.txt.gz files are 100% integers (library sizes 12.3-16.7 M), described in data_processing as 'counts value (the number of reads for each gene in each sample)' from eXpress. The merged tar interleaved FPKM columns, which the prep script dropped. Paper input is counts for DESeq2 (S2.8.p1).

final.analysis_type: multi-group, one factor with three levels

contrasts.name: grp_Sham_vs_NE
contrasts.note: paper reports NE/Ovx vs Sham; sign is flipped relative to the paper (NE vs Sham up = Sham vs NE down)

candidates.value: pool Sham and NE as control
candidates.reason_rejected: Sham is not ovariectomized; pooling would mix the OVX model effect into the exercise contrast
not a planned paper contrast; confounds exercise with ovariectomy

design.reasoning: One factor (grp) with three levels; reference NE/Ovx so the exercise contrast RE vs NE is direct (S3.4.p2). NE vs Sham is kept as the paper's secondary model contrast; it is fitted as Sham vs NE from the same model and its sign is reversed when compared with the paper.

covariance.reasoning: Independent rats, one tibia each, no batch, sex, or lane columns in metadata (all female, S2.1.p1).

deviations: exact paper design (all 9 samples vs per-pair subset) unknown; primary uses one model on all 9 samples, sensitivity refits each pair alone
GEO data_processing names DESeq (2012) nbinomTest with p <= 0.05 and FC >= 2, which contradicts the paper (DESeq2, FC 1.2); paper followed

method.reasoning: Integer counts -> DESeq2 as in S2.8.p1.

final.deviation_note: Paper rule: p < 0.05 and FC > 1.2 or FC < 0.83 (S2.8.p1). log2(1.2) = 0.2630344; the down rule FC < 0.83 is log2FC < -0.2688 (vs -0.2630 for 1/1.2). The runner takes one symmetric cutoff, so the down side uses 1/1.2; the exact asymmetric count is computed from the result table in HANDBACK.md. Raw p, as the paper states; BH padj < 0.05 audit reported separately.

threshold.reasoning: S2.8.p1 verbatim: p-value < 0.05 and foldchange >1.2 or <0.83.

caveats: paper's raw-p threshold without multiple-testing correction
paper's 401/213 OP-related DEG subsets need DisGeNET/OMIM gene lists not reproduced here
NE vs Sham fitted as Sham vs NE (sign flipped)

study.reasoning: Paper's primary exercise contrast is reproduced with its method and threshold.

discrepancies.data: GEO data_processing: DESeq (2012) estimateSizeFactors + nbinomTest, p <= 0.05 and FC >= 2
titles Sham_12/7/8, Ovx_NE_6/8/9, Ovx_RE_3/5/8 (animal numbers); counts file headers say Sham_1..; mapping by GSM accession

executions.reasoning: One DESeq2 model ~ grp on all 9 samples, planned contrasts RE vs NE (primary) and Sham vs NE (secondary).

executions.reasoning: Pairwise DESeq2 on the 6 OVX samples only, in case the paper fitted each comparison separately.
